title: The Impact of Sizing in Options Trading
text: This is showing you a strategy that is sized at three different levels. The strategy has positive edge by itself. It's about 3.5% per dollar at risk. What I'm doing then is showing a 300 trade derivation of that where we're simulating 4,000 paths. So, it's taking something that has edge and then it's simulating it at these different sizes. So, the one time size is the base size for this is 12.5% risk per trade. That's the yellow line. Then you have the blue line, which is two times that, and then that orange line, which is four times that. What I'm showing you is that this is the same strategy, the same trade, the same edge. But, the way that you size it has a massive impact on your performance. That's why sizing is so important.
